Final_Declaration: Four traits retained: Wood Density, Specific Leaf Area, log10 Seed Mass, and Maximum Height.
All four analysis-scale traits standardized by z-score using the 126 complete four-trait taxa.
No moderate or strong pairwise trait redundancy detected.
Full standardized four-dimensional space retained for distance-based functional analyses.
PC1-PC2 retained as primary 2-D visualization; PC1-PC2-PC3 retained for extended ecological interpretation.
Wood Density, Seed Mass, and Maximum Height show significant Habitat × Zone interactions; SLA shows a significant Zone effect.
FDis retained as the principal FD response.
RaoQ retained as corroborative because of strong redundancy with FDis.
FEve and FRic retained as supplementary metrics because structural missingness prevents complete 90-plot coverage.
Higher community-weighted log10 Seed Mass is robustly associated with lower functional diversity across pooled, design-adjusted, within-cell, and multivariable analyses.
HC3-robust Type III inference used as the authoritative factorial framework; Holm and FDR corrections applied where appropriate.
Associations are observational and are not interpreted causally.
